# Wait Until

Source: [9298](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/9298); edited 2026-07-16. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Wait Until](../../api/actions/wait-until.md).

<a id="wiki-9298-n1"></a>

- Wait Until ends when its continue predicate is true or timeout elapses; it ignores the rule's conditions during the wait.

<a id="wiki-9298-n2"></a>

- It may pass after zero ticks and has no one-tick minimum.

Source limitations:

- Action reference omits predicate invalidation/reevaluation pitfalls reported elsewhere; do not treat it as a complete polling model.
